checks.name: the tonemap shader part exists and is non-trivial
the tonemap shader exposes the six Hable/Unreal constants A–F
f(1) = 1 (white point maps to display white)
f(1000) is finite and ≤ HDR ceiling (8.0)
output is non-negative for negative input (clamped at 0)
the curve is monotonically non-decreasing on [0, 200]
no NaN or Infinity across the exposure range (×2^-4 .. ×2^4)
five overlapping stars are brighter than one
five stars at the white-point map to ~1.0 (SDR white)
the gain is sub-linear (compressive, not multiplicative)
linear exposure covers 6 stops (8× min to 8× max)
at default exposure, the curve sees the raw summed flux
the HDR intermediate format is rgba16float
